verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own company-formation flow: owners can form a business (explicitly an LLC) and register an EIN in one guided online flow, backed by registered agent and initial-report services. However, the flow is in early beta, and nothing in the evidence covers Delaware corporation incorporation, bylaws, or initial board approvals. Missing for 10: Delaware C-corp incorporation, bylaws generation, initial board consents/approvals, general availability beyond early beta, independent hands-on corroboration of the formation flow.
